segments.text: We need a realistic finish line for the Atlas migration.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: The legacy export contains 1.8 million records across four collections.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: The account table has inconsistent time zones in older rows.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Can we move the customer accounts first?
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Yes, accounts can move in the September rehearsal.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: The rehearsal needs a masked copy of production data.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Who owns the masking script?
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: I do, and I can deliver it by August eighth.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: The second wave contains billing and document links.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: What date can we promise for the complete cutover?
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: If the October rehearsal passes, the switch is on October thirty-first.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: We need two days for rollback validation before that.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: So rollback exercises happen October twenty-ninth and thirtieth.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Correct, and the old system remains read-only for two weeks.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: The document links are the biggest uncertainty.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Should we reserve a contingency week?
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Yes. If checks fail, we defer the switch to November seventh.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: I will build a checksum report for each collection.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Can the reporting team work during the switch?
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: Dashboards will pause for roughly ninety minutes.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: I will notify them three business days ahead.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: What is the success criterion for the rehearsal?
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: All account totals must match, and broken links must stay below one tenth of a percent.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: We can sample five hundred documents by hand as well.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Please document the sample results in the runbook.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: The runbook needs named owners for every rollback step.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: I can draft that section next Monday.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: We should explain the date to the client without promising zero downtime.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: I will say the full migration is planned for October thirty-first.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: I will attach the ninety minute maintenance estimate.
segments.speaker: remote

segments.text: Good. We will review readiness at the October twenty-sixth checkpoint.
segments.speaker: me

segments.text: I will bring the rehearsal metrics then.
segments.speaker: remote
